about: Line 18's master plan on the plateau (lot ligne18 and its children), FROZEN: made by tools/ligne18/build_plan.py (OSM + the map's ground of 2026-11-13); sources: ref/metro18/README.md.

frame.xy: map metres, x east, y north (Lambert-93 minus 641117.6, 6846184.3)
frame.z: metres over the map origin's height (157.731 m NGF), as the heightmap
frame.godot: position (x, z, -y); heading theta (radians, from +x towards +y) = rotation.y
frame.s: chainage, m along the axis from Massy-Palaiseau, westwards; PK = s + 9075.7
frame.station_frame: u along the line (increasing s, the heading), v to its left; origin on the axis at the station's s; Godot local (u, z - hall_z, -v) under a node at the centre, rotation.y = heading

track.third_rail: on each track's inner side (towards the axis): the platforms' side stays clear

viaduct.half_section_note: the deck's outline, v >= 0 (mirror it), z over the rail's top: the spine (walkway at the train floor) between the tracks, the deck slab, its thin edges, the soffit sloping down to the spine's foot
viaduct.ramp_note: s_start..s_abutment: the ramp, an embankment between retaining walls (the rail 0.5 m over the ground at s_start, 3 %); s_abutment..s_edge: spans on piers
viaduct.colour: light concrete (very light grey); stainless cable guard rails
